# Repository instructions

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), the
[constitution](../.specify/memory/constitution.md), and the
[architecture guardrails](../docs/agent-architecture-guardrails.md) before repository work.
These apply to edits, reviews and delegated agents. Evaluate CC-09 as well as CC-01..CC-08;
a passing typecheck does not establish architectural compliance.
